title: Grateful Dead Live at Travelodge Theatre in the Round on 1970-03-08

ai_review.summary: Decent‑sounding recording with mixed reactions to the performance, particularly the vocalist/harpist.
ai_review.review: The audience notes that the sound is "pretty good," but the release suffers from mislabeled track titles and a lack of detailed mix information. Reviewers are split on the musical side – some enjoy the ambience while others find Pigpen’s vocals and harmonica irritating, resulting in an overall mixed impression of the show.

ai_rating.rationale: Limited detail on performance and recording; positive note on sound quality balanced by negative comments about the vocalist, yielding an average‑ish rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Sound described as decent, but track titles are mislabeled (Hard to Handle listed as Dire Wolf). No specific comments on mix clarity or source type.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No concrete remarks about set structure; reviewers focus on atmosphere and individual performer rather than song flow.

band_member_comments.Keys: Pigpen's vocals/harp are called irritating and unable to sing well by some reviewers, while others defend his presence.
